menuPauseSection.title: Pausing from the in-game Menu
paragraphs: While Menu, Settings, Jukebox, Save, or Load is open from within a running game, automation and background visual effects stop. A GAME PAUSED status appears in the Menu.

When Menu closes, the simulation resumes from the same moment and does not process the time spent paused. Disable this option under Settings > General if automation and background visual effects should continue while you navigate the Menu.

Paused Menu time is excluded from total play time. Resource regeneration timers, research timers, autosaves, and delayed game events do not advance; saving from a paused Menu preserves the same frozen game clock.

newGame.title: New Game
newGame.subtitle: Choose your game mode and save slot
newGame.standardModeDesc: Classic factory-building experience. Your goal is to produce one hyperdrive engine through strategic resource management and technological research. Build your industrial empire step by step, unlock new technologies, and optimize production chains. No time limits or additional constraints — just pure manufacturing progression at your own pace.
newGame.realisticModeDesc: Advanced challenge for experienced players. Same goal — produce one hyperdrive engine — but with critical environmental constraints. Monitor harmful emissions from your factories and prioritize eco-friendly energy sources and alternative production methods. Balance industrial progress with planetary health, or risk catastrophic pollution leading to game over. Requires strategic planning and sustainable resource management.
